description: Does a limit we hold say what a claim says? Give the claim as read from a sentence (an AI's answer, a report): parameter, value and unit, and the place, medium and statistic when the sentence gives them. The verdict: confirmed (a held row prints the same number, in that unit or one that converts exactly, under that statistic: quote its `cite`); contradicted (rows are held and none prints it: `held_otherwise` gives the number each prints, with its cite); not_held (a coded `refused` block naming every instrument searched and its edition: say that our sources hold no such row, never that the claim is false or that the place has no limit); not_comparable (rows held, none comparable with one number, each with its `why`). Equal is equal as exact decimals: a rounded number is another number. Each row's conditions ride with it, and a row printing another number under other conditions (another kind of facility, another hardness) may be why a claim is contradicted: say whose conditions are the claim's. Optionally give the `sentence` the claim came from: the answer says whether it prints the claim's number and unit. The sentence is never kept.

medium.description: What the claimed limit governs: an effluent (water_discharge), the receiving water (surface_water), groundwater, drinking_water, soil, air.

parameter.description: The substance or measure the claim names (copper, ammonia, pH) or its CAS number.

place.description: ISO 3166 code of where the rule binds: a country (US, CA, DE, FR, IT), a state or province (US-OH, CA-QC), or EU. A place also searches every place above it: US-OH searches US-OH and US; DE searches DE and EU. Omit to search everywhere.

sentence.description: Optional: the sentence the claim was read from. Read for the claim's number and unit, never kept.

statistic.description: The claim's statistic as a row code: monthly_avg (a monthly mean or average), thirty_day_avg (an average over 30 days, as a standard prints it), daily_max, daily_avg, weekly_avg, annual_avg, hourly_avg, four_day_avg, instant (a grab sample, at any time), composite, qualified_grab, ... An unknown code is refused with the list. Omit it and every row is set beside the claim.

unit.description: The claim's unit: mg/L, µg/L (or ug/L, mg L-1), ng/L, mg/kg, µg/m³, pH ...

value.description: The number the claim states (0.10). A decimal string is read too, with a point or one decimal comma (0,10).

name: verify_claim
title: Verify a claimed limit
